WITH job_days AS (
    SELECT EMPLOYEE_ID,
           SUM(julianday(END_DATE) - julianday(START_DATE)) AS days_in_history
    FROM job_history
    GROUP BY EMPLOYEE_ID
)
SELECT e.EMPLOYEE_ID, e.FIRST_NAME, e.LAST_NAME
FROM employees e
LEFT JOIN job_days jd ON e.EMPLOYEE_ID = jd.EMPLOYEE_ID
WHERE ((julianday('now') - julianday(e.HIRE_DATE)) + IFNULL(jd.days_in_history, 0)) / 365 >= 5;

SELECT e.EMPLOYEE_ID,
       e.FIRST_NAME,
       e.LAST_NAME,
       CASE
         WHEN (julianday('now') - julianday(e.HIRE_DATE)) / 365.25 >= 10
              OR e.SALARY >= 20000 THEN 'Senior'
         WHEN (julianday('now') - julianday(e.HIRE_DATE)) / 365.25 >= 5
              OR e.SALARY >= 12000 THEN 'Mid'
         ELSE 'Junior'
       END AS seniority_level
FROM employees e
ORDER BY e.EMPLOYEE_ID;

WITH emp_sen AS (
  SELECT e.EMPLOYEE_ID,
         e.FIRST_NAME || ' ' || e.LAST_NAME AS full_name,
         d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
         (julianday('now') - julianday(e.HIRE_DATE)) / 365.25 AS years_employed,
         CASE
           WHEN (julianday('now') - julianday(e.HIRE_DATE)) / 365.25 >= 5 THEN 'senior'
           WHEN (julianday('now') - julianday(e.HIRE_DATE)) / 365.25 >= 2 THEN 'mid-level'
           ELSE 'junior'
         END AS seniority_category,
         CASE
           WHEN (julianday('now') - julianday(e.HIRE_DATE)) / 365.25 >= 5 THEN 3
           WHEN (julianday('now') - julianday(e.HIRE_DATE)) / 365.25 >= 2 THEN 2
           ELSE 1
         END AS seniority_level,
         (julianday('now') - julianday(e.HIRE_DATE)) / 365.25 AS years
  FROM employees e
  JOIN departments d ON e.DEPARTMENT_ID = d.DEPARTMENT_ID
  WHERE e.DEPARTMENT_ID IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT full_name,
       DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
       seniority_category
FROM (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
                            ORDER BY seniority_level DESC, years DESC) AS rn
  FROM emp_sen
) sub
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, rn;

WITH emp_tenure AS (
    SELECT
        e.employee_id,
        e.first_name,
        e.last_name,
        e.department_id,
        d.department_name,
        (CASE
            WHEN (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', e.hire_date))
            THEN (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', e.hire_date)) - 1
            ELSE (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', e.hire_date))
        END) AS years_employed
    FROM employees e
    JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        employee_id,
        first_name || ' ' || last_name AS full_name,
        department_name,
        years_employed,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY years_employed DESC) AS rn
    FROM emp_tenure
)
SELECT
    full_name,
    department_name,
    CASE
        WHEN rn = 1 THEN 'senior'
        WHEN rn = 2 THEN 'mid-level'
        ELSE 'junior'
    END AS seniority_category
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY department_name, rn;

votes.sql:
WITH emp_adj AS (
  SELECT
    e.EMPLOYEE_ID,
    e.FIRST_NAME,
    e.LAST_NAME,
    e.DEPARTMENT_ID,
    (e.SALARY + COALESCE(e.SALARY * e.COMMISSION_PCT, 0)) * 0.85 AS adjusted_eur
  FROM employees e
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    ea.*,
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    (ea.FIRST_NAME || ' ' || ea.LAST_NAME) AS full_name,
    AVG(ea.adjusted_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY ea.DEPARTMENT_ID) AS dept_avg_eur,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ea.DEPARTMENT_ID ORDER BY ea.adjusted_eur DESC) AS rn
  FROM emp_adj ea
  JOIN departments d ON d.DEPARTMENT_ID = ea.DEPARTMENT_ID
)
SELECT
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  full_name,
  adjusted_eur,
  dept_avg_eur
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, adjusted_eur DESC;

WITH emp_data AS (
    SELECT 
        d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        e.FIRST_NAME || ' ' || e.LAST_NAME AS EMPLOYEE_NAME,
        e.SALARY * (1 + COALESCE(e.COMMISSION_PCT, 0)) * 0.9 AS ADJUSTED_COMP_EUR,
        e.DEPARTMENT_ID,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY e.DEPARTMENT_ID 
            ORDER BY e.SALARY * (1 + COALESCE(e.COMMISSION_PCT, 0)) DESC
        ) AS rnk
    FROM employees e
    INNER JOIN departments d ON e.DEPARTMENT_ID = d.DEPARTMENT_ID
    WHERE e.DEPARTMENT_ID IS NOT NULL
),
dept_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        DEPARTMENT_ID,
        AVG(SALARY * (1 + COALESCE(COMMISSION_PCT, 0)) * 0.9) AS DEPT_AVG_ADJUSTED_COMP
    FROM employees
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_ID IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_ID
)
SELECT 
    ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ed.EMPLOYEE_NAME,
    ed.ADJUSTED_COMP_EUR,
    da.DEPT_AVG_ADJUSTED_COMP
FROM emp_data ed
INNER JOIN dept_avg da ON ed.DEPARTMENT_ID = da.DEPARTMENT_ID
WHERE ed.rnk <= 3
ORDER BY ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ed.ADJUSTED_COMP_EUR DESC;

WITH params AS (SELECT 0.85 AS usd_to_eur),
     emp_adj AS (
        SELECT
           e.EMPLOYEE_ID,
           d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
           e.FIRST_NAME || ' ' || e.LAST_NAME AS full_name,
           (e.SALARY + COALESCE(e.SALARY * e.COMMISSION_PCT, 0)) * p.usd_to_eur AS adj_comp,
           AVG((e.SALARY + COALESCE(e.SALARY * e.COMMISSION_PCT, 0)) * p.usd_to_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY e.DEPARTMENT_ID) AS dept_avg_adj
        FROM employees e
        JOIN departments d ON e.DEPARTMENT_ID = d.DEPARTMENT_ID
        CROSS JOIN params p
     ),
     ranked AS (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY adj_comp DESC) AS rn
        FROM emp_adj
     )
SELECT
   DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
   full_name AS employee_full_name,
   adj_comp AS adjusted_compensation_eur,
   dept_avg_adj AS department_average_adjusted_compensation_eur
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, adj_comp DESC;

WITH comp AS (
    SELECT
        e.employee_id,
        e.first_name,
        e.last_name,
        e.department_id,
        e.salary,
        e.commission_pct,
        (e.salary + (e.salary * COALESCE(e.commission_pct, 0))) AS total_comp
    FROM employees e
),
max_comp AS (
    SELECT
        department_id,
        MAX(total_comp) AS max_total_comp
    FROM comp
    GROUP BY department_id
)
SELECT
    c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS employee_name,
    d.department_name,
    c.total_comp AS total_compensation
FROM comp c
JOIN max_comp mc ON c.department_id = mc.department_id AND c.total_comp = mc.max_total_comp
JOIN departments d ON c.department_id = d.department_id
ORDER BY d.department_name;

votes.sql:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT e.FIRST_NAME || ' ' || e.LAST_NAME AS employee_name,
           d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
           e.SALARY * 0.85 AS euro_salary,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.DEPARTMENT_ID ORDER BY e.SALARY DESC) AS rn
    FROM employees e
    JOIN departments d ON e.DEPARTMENT_ID = d.DEPARTMENT_ID
    WHERE e.SALARY IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT employee_name, DEPARTMENT_NAME, euro_salary
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, euro_salary DESC;

SELECT r.REGION_NAME,
       CASE 
           WHEN ((julianday('now') - julianday(e.HIRE_DATE))/365.25) < 3 THEN 'Junior'
           WHEN ((julianday('now') - julianday(e.HIRE_DATE))/365.25) < 7 THEN 'Mid-level'
           ELSE 'Senior'
       END AS seniority,
       AVG(e.SALARY) * 0.85 AS avg_salary_eur
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.DEPARTMENT_ID = d.DEPARTMENT_ID
JOIN locations l ON d.LOCATION_ID = l.LOCATION_ID
JOIN countries c ON l.COUNTRY_ID = c.COUNTRY_ID
JOIN regions r ON c.REGION_ID = r.REGION_ID
GROUP BY r.REGION_NAME,
         seniority
ORDER BY r.REGION_NAME,
         CASE seniority
             WHEN 'Junior' THEN 1
             WHEN 'Mid-level' THEN 2
             WHEN 'Senior' THEN 3
         END;

WITH employee_tenure AS (
    SELECT 
        e.EMPLOYEE_ID,
        e.SALARY,
        e.HIRE_DATE,
        r.REGION_NAME,
        CAST(julianday('now') - julianday(e.HIRE_DATE) AS INTEGER) / 365.25 AS years_with_company
    FROM employees e
    INNER JOIN departments d ON e.DEPARTMENT_ID = d.DEPARTMENT_ID
    INNER JOIN locations l ON d.LOCATION_ID = l.LOCATION_ID
    INNER JOIN countries c ON l.COUNTRY_ID = c.COUNTRY_ID
    INNER JOIN regions r ON c.REGION_ID = r.REGION_ID
),
seniority_levels AS (
    SELECT 
        REGION_NAME,
        CASE 
            WHEN years_with_company <= 3 THEN 'Junior'
            WHEN years_with_company BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Mid-level'
            ELSE 'Senior'
        END AS seniority_level,
        SALARY
    FROM employee_tenure
    WHERE SALARY IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    REGION_NAME,
    seniority_level,
    ROUND(AVG(SALARY) * 0.85, 2) AS avg_salary_eur
FROM seniority_levels
GROUP BY REGION_NAME, seniority_level
ORDER BY REGION_NAME, seniority_level;

votes.sql:
WITH employee_experience AS (
    SELECT
        e.EMPLOYEE_ID,
        e.FIRST_NAME,
        e.LAST_NAME,
        e.HIRE_DATE,
        e.SALARY,
        e.DEPARTMENT_ID,
        COALESCE(SUM((julianday(jh.END_DATE) - julianday(jh.START_DATE)) / 365.25), 0) +
        (julianday('2024-01-01') - julianday(e.HIRE_DATE)) / 365.25 AS total_experience_years
    FROM employees e
    LEFT JOIN job_history jh ON e.EMPLOYEE_ID = jh.EMPLOYEE_ID
    GROUP BY e.EMPLOYEE_ID
)
SELECT
    ee.FIRST_NAME || ' ' || ee.LAST_NAME AS name,
    ee.HIRE_DATE,
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department,
    CASE
        WHEN ee.total_experience_years < 3 THEN 'Junior'
        WHEN ee.total_experience_years < 7 THEN 'Mid'
        ELSE 'Senior'
    END AS experience_level,
    ROUND(ee.SALARY * (1 + 0.02 * (2024 - CAST(strftime('%Y', ee.HIRE_DATE) AS INTEGER))), 2) AS adjusted_salary
FROM employee_experience ee
LEFT JOIN departments d ON ee.DEPARTMENT_ID = d.DEPARTMENT_ID
ORDER BY name;

SELECT 
    e.FIRST_NAME || ' ' || e.LAST_NAME AS name,
    e.HIRE_DATE,
    COALESCE(d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'No Department') AS department,
    CASE 
        WHEN CAST((julianday('2024-01-01') - julianday(e.HIRE_DATE)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) < 2 THEN 'Junior'
        WHEN CAST((julianday('2024-01-01') - julianday(e.HIRE_DATE)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2 AND 7 THEN 'Mid'
        ELSE 'Senior'
    END AS experience_level,
    ROUND(e.SALARY * 1.4, 2) AS adjusted_salary_2024
FROM employees e
LEFT JOIN departments d ON e.DEPARTMENT_ID = d.DEPARTMENT_ID
WHERE e.HIRE_DATE IS NOT NULL;

WITH emp_region AS (
  SELECT e.EMPLOYEE_ID,
         e.FIRST_NAME,
         e.LAST_NAME,
         e.SALARY,
         r.REGION_NAME,
         (julianday('now') - julianday(e.HIRE_DATE))/365.25 AS years_exp
  FROM employees e
  JOIN departments d ON e.DEPARTMENT_ID = d.DEPARTMENT_ID
  JOIN locations l ON d.LOCATION_ID = l.LOCATION_ID
  JOIN countries c ON l.COUNTRY_ID = c.COUNTRY_ID
  JOIN regions r ON c.REGION_ID = r.REGION_ID
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY REGION_NAME ORDER BY SALARY DESC) AS rn,
         CASE
           WHEN years_exp < 3 THEN 'Junior'
           WHEN years_exp < 7 THEN 'Mid-level'
           ELSE 'Senior'
         END AS level
  FROM emp_region
)
SELECT REGION_NAME,
       EMPLOYEE_ID,
       FIRST_NAME || ' ' || LAST_NAME AS employee_name,
       level,
       ROUND(SALARY * 0.85, 2) AS salary_eur
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY REGION_NAME, rn;

        salary_euros,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY REGION_NAME ORDER BY SALARY DESC) AS region_rank
    FROM extended_calculation
)
SELECT 
    employee_name,
    experience_level,
    salary_euros
FROM ranked_employees
WHERE region_rank <= 3;

WITH emp_stats AS (
  SELECT
    e.employee_id,
    e.first_name,
    e.last_name,
    e.salary,
    e.job_id,
    e.hire_date,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY e.job_id ORDER BY e.salary DESC) AS salary_percentile,
    (julianday('now') - julianday(e.hire_date)) / 365.25 AS years_of_service
  FROM employees e
  WHERE e.salary IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT employee_id,
       first_name,
       last_name
FROM emp_stats
WHERE salary_percentile <= 0.1
  AND years_of_service >= 5;

SELECT r.REGION_NAME,
       SUM(e.SALARY) AS total_salary_eur
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.DEPARTMENT_ID = d.DEPARTMENT_ID

JOIN regions r ON c.REGION_ID = r.REGION_ID
GROUP BY r.REGION_ID;

votes.sql:
WITH emp_rank AS (
    SELECT e.EMPLOYEE_ID,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.DEPARTMENT_ID ORDER BY e.SALARY DESC) AS rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY e.DEPARTMENT_ID) AS dept_cnt
    FROM employees e
)
SELECT EMPLOYEE_ID,
       CASE 
           WHEN grade_idx = 0 THEN 'A'
           WHEN grade_idx = 1 THEN 'B'
           WHEN grade_idx = 2 THEN 'C'
           WHEN grade_idx = 3 THEN 'D'
           WHEN grade_idx = 4 THEN 'E'
           ELSE 'F'
       END AS salary_grade
FROM (
    SELECT EMPLOYEE_ID,
           CAST(((rn - 1) * 6) / dept_cnt AS INTEGER) AS grade_idx
    FROM emp_rank
) sub
ORDER BY EMPLOYEE_ID;
